announcements.headline: Ipsos announced that it filed a complaint on Wednesday, 11 November regarding a breach on one of its internal information systems
announcements.insight: While Ipsos operates in a data-intensive sector where cybersecurity is critical, this appears to be an isolated internal system breach rather than a widespread infrastructure failure; such routine IT incidents rarely impact long-term valuation unless they trigger significant regulatory fines or client attrition.
